Comment: Stationary support infrastructure: workshop tiers, fuel depot, parts, garage, wash bay, reservoir, pump and compressor stations, hydrants, utility prices. All figures 2020s European resort practice.

WorkshopTiers.Comment: One heated bay, hand tools, a chain hoist. Filters, track pads and blade edges; everything else goes to the dealer.
Two bays, a 5 t hoist, hydraulic hose crimper and a parts room: hydraulic pumps and cylinders in-house.
Three bays, engine crane, diagnostic laptop licences for every make: engine and drivetrain repairs without the dealer truck.
Five bays, wash-down pit, machining and a dyno: mid-life rebuilds in-house, the fleet keeps its resale value.

FuelDepot.Comment: Double-walled above-ground diesel tank with a dispenser; a tanker delivery takes a day to arrange. Contract pricing indexes the spot price minus 6 %; a spot order in a cold snap pays 15 % over.

PartsKinds.Comment: Oil, fuel, hydraulic and air filters plus fluids for one preventive service.
Injectors, turbo, gaskets: the parts behind most engine failures.
Final drive seals, planetary set, sprocket.
Variable-displacement pump or motor for the implement or track circuit.
A set of rubber belts, grousers and guide wheels.
Four wheeled-machine tyres or a full snowmobile track.
Starter battery, alternator, cold-weather harness parts.

Garage.Comment: A heated bay per machine keeps hydraulics warm and the cold-start lottery away; a cat left outside at -20 C wears 30 % faster.

WashBay.Comment: Heated wash bay with an oil separator: salt and grit off the undercarriage every night cuts wear about 8 %.

Reservoir.Comment: Lined storage pond fed by a stream right: 60,000 m3 makes about 130,000 m3 of snow; the creek refills it at 8 m3/h in winter.

PumpStations.Comment: Two 130 kW multistage pumps: 60 L/s at 300 m head, enough for eight fan guns.
Mid-mountain booster: doubles the flow and pushes water to the shoulder.
Destination-resort plant: 200 L/s to the ridge, feeds forty guns.

CompressorStations.Comment: Two screw compressors for a bank of lance guns.
Air for a full lance-gun run.
